translations.eng: When I heard the tragic news, I was deeply moved with grief.
translations.amh: አሳዛኙን ዜና ስሰማ ሆዴ ባባ።
translations.orm: Oduu gaddisiisaa sana yeroon dhaga'u garaan koo baay'ee na laafe.
translations.tir: ነቲ ዘሕዝን ዜና ምስ ሰማዕኩ ልበይ ሰንበደ።
translations.som: Markii aan warka naxdinta leh maqlay, aad baan uga tiiraanyooday.

translations.eng: Without a specific plan, I wandered wherever my feet carried me.
translations.amh: ምንም ያቀድኩት ቦታ ስላልነበረ እግሬ ያወጣኝ ቦታ ሄድኩ።
translations.orm: Bakka itti yaade waanan hin qabneef bakka miilli koo na geessetti deeme.
translations.tir: ዝሓሰብክዎ ቦታ ስለዘይነበረኒ ኣእጋረይ ናብ ዝመርሓኒ ከድኩ።
translations.som: Maadaama aysan jirin meel ii qorshaysan, meeshii cagahaygu i geeyaan ayaan aaday.

translations.eng: An elder leader must be tolerant, patient, and broad-minded.
translations.amh: አንድ ሽማግሌ መሪ ሆደ ሰፊ፣ ታጋሽ እና አስተዋይ መሆን አለበት።
translations.orm: Hogganaan manguddoon garaa bal'aa, obsaa fi hubataa ta'uu qaba.
translations.tir: ሓደ ሽማግለ መራሒ ዓቃል፣ ሰፊሕ ከብዲ ዘለዎን ኣስተውዓልን ክኸውን ኣለዎ።
translations.som: Hogaamiyaha waayeelka ahi waa inuu noqdaa mid dulqaad badan, calool furan, oo xikmad leh.

translations.eng: The surroundings are spinning around me and I feel dizzy.
translations.amh: አይኔ እየጨለመ ራሴን እያዞረኝ ነው።
translations.orm: Lafti natti maraa jira, sammuun koo na naanna'eera.
translations.tir: ኣዒንተይ እናጸልመተ ርእሰይ የዕዘረኒ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Aduunka ayaa igu wareegaya oo aad baan u wareersanahay.

translations.eng: After resolving the family dispute, my heart finally found rest and peace.
translations.amh: የቤተሰቡ አለመግባባት ከተፈታ በኋላ በመጨረሻ ልቤ አረፈ።
translations.orm: Wal dhabdeen maatii sun erga furamee booda onneen koo boqonnaa fi nagaa argate.
translations.tir: እቲ ናይ ስድራቤት ዘይምርድዳእ ምስ ተፈትሐ ኣብ መወዳእታ ልበይ ዓሪፉ።
translations.som: Kaddib markii murankii qoyska la xalliyay, qalbigaygu wuxuu helay nabad iyo degganaan.

translations.eng: I cannot attend the meeting today because my hands are completely tied with urgent work.
translations.amh: አስቸኳይ ስራ እጄን ስለያዘው ዛሬ በስብሰባው ላይ መገኘት አልችልም።
translations.orm: Hojiin ariifachiisaan harka koo waan qabeef har'a walga'ii irratti argamuu hin danda'u.
translations.tir: ህጹጽ ስራሕ ኣእዳወይ ስለዝተሓዘ ሎሚ ኣብቲ ኣኼባ ክርከብ ኣይክእልን እየ።
translations.som: Maadaama hawl degdeg ahi gacmahayga buuxisay, maanta kama qaybgeli karo kulanka.

translations.eng: He is bold and fearless when defending the rights of the poor.
translations.amh: የድሆችን መብት በሚከራከርበት ጊዜ አይነ ደረቅ እና ደፋር ነው።
translations.orm: Mirga hiyyeeyyii yeroo falmu ija jabaa fi goota sodaachisaadha.
translations.tir: ንመሰል ድኻታት ክጣበቕ ከሎ ተባዕን ዘይፈርሕን እዩ።
translations.som: Waa nin dhiirran oo aan cabsanayn markuu u doodayo xuquuqda masaakiinta.

translations.eng: The community welcomed the honored guests with open arms and warmth.
translations.amh: ማህበረሰቡ የተከበሩትን እንግዶች በክብርና በሞቀ እቅፍ ተቀበላቸው።
translations.orm: Hawaasichi keessummoota kabajamoo harka bal'aa fi miira ho'aadhaan simate.
translations.tir: እቲ ማሕበረሰብ ነቶም ክቡራት ኣጋይሽ ብኽፉት ኣእዳውን ብሞቕሳን ተቐበሎም።
translations.som: Bulshadu waxay martidii sharafta lahayd ku soo dhoweysay gacmo furan iyo kalgacal.

translations.eng: When spider webs unite, they can tie up a lion.
translations.amh: ድር ቢያብር አንበሳ ያስር።
translations.orm: Dallaan gamtaa waraabessa dhowwa.
translations.tir: ሓሳብ እንተ ሓቢሩስ ኣንበሳ ይኣስር።
translations.som: Gacmo wada jir bay wax ku gooyaan.

translations.eng: Slowly and with patience, sour unripe fruit turns sweet.
translations.amh: ቀስ በቀስ በእንቁላል እግር እርምጃ ጎምዛዛው ፍሬ ይጣፍጣል።
translations.orm: Suuta suutaan killeen miilla baasti.
translations.tir: ቀስ ብቐስ ብዕግስቲ መጺጽ ፍረ ይምቅር።
translations.som: Sabartaa caano macaan cabta.

translations.eng: The farmer plowed the fertile field before the heavy rain started.
translations.amh: ገበሬው ከባድ ዝናብ ከመጀመሩ በፊት ለም የሆነውን እርሻ አረሰ።
translations.orm: Qonnaan bulaan bokkaan cimaan jalqabuun dura maasii gabbataa qote.
translations.tir: እቲ ሓረስታይ ብርቱዕ ዝናብ ቅድሚ ምጅማሩ ነቲ ለምለም ሕርሻ ሓረሶ።
translations.som: Beeralaydu waxay falteen beertii barwaaqada ahayd ka hor inta uusan roobka xooggan bilaaban.

translations.eng: The merchant did not sell his teff because the offered price was too low.
translations.amh: ነጋዴው የቀረበለት ዋጋ በጣም ዝቅተኛ ስለነበረ ጤፉን አልሸጠም።
translations.orm: Daldalaan gatiin dhiyaateef baay'ee gadi aanaa waan ta'eef xaafii isaa hin gurgurre.
translations.tir: እቲ ነጋዳይ ዝቐረበሉ ዋጋ ኣዝዩ ትሑት ስለዝነበረ ጣፉ ኣይሸጦን።
translations.som: Ganacsaduhu ma iibinin daafidiisii sababtoo ah qiimaha loo soo bandhigay ayaa aad u hooseeyay.

translations.eng: The university students are studying diligently for their national exit examination.
translations.amh: የዩኒቨርሲቲው ተማሪዎች ለብሔራዊ መውጫ ፈተናቸው በትጋት እያጠኑ ነው።
translations.orm: Barattoonni yuunivarsitii qormaata bahiinsaa biyyoolessaaf cimanii qo'achaa jiru.
translations.tir: እቶም ተምሃሮ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ነቲ ናይ ምውጻእ ሃገራዊ ፈተነኦም ብትግሃት የጽንዑ ኣለዉ።
translations.som: Ardayda jaamacaddu waxay si dadaal leh ugu baranayaan imtixaankooda bixitaanka ee qaranka.

translations.eng: The patient is not responding to speech and is not breathing regularly.
translations.amh: ህመምተኛው ለንግግር ምላሽ እየሰጠ አይደለም፣ እንዲሁም በአግባቡ እየተነፈሰ አይደለም።
translations.orm: Dhukkubsataan dubbiif deebii kennaa hin jiru, sirriittis hafuura baafachaa hin jiru.
translations.tir: እቲ ሕሙም ንዘረባ ምላሽ ይህብ የለን፣ ከምኡ’ውን ብስርዓት የስተንፍስ የለን።
translations.som: Bukaanku kama jawaabayo hadalka, si joogto ahna uma neefsanayo.

translations.eng: We will transfer the remaining funds tomorrow morning through Telebirr.
translations.amh: ቀሪውን ክፍያ ነገ ጠዋት በቴሌብር እናስተላልፋለን።
translations.orm: Kaffaltii hafe boru ganama Telebirriidhaan ni dabarsina.
translations.tir: ነቲ ዝተረፈ ገንዘብ ጽባሕ ንግሆ ብቴሌብር ከነመሓላልፎ ኢና።
translations.som: Lacagta hartay waxaan ku wareejin doonnaa berrito subaxdii Telebirr.

translations.eng: The intercity bus will not depart until all passengers fasten their seatbelts.
translations.amh: ሁሉም ተሳፋሪዎች የወገብ ቀበቶ ሳያስሩ አውቶቡሱ አይነሳም።
translations.orm: Imaltoonni hundi qabattoo isaanii utuu hin hidhatin otobisichi hin ka'u.
translations.tir: ኩሎም ተጓዓዝቲ መቐነቶም ከይኣሰሩ እቲ ኣውቶቡስ ኣይክብገስን እዩ።
translations.som: Baska gobollada u kala goosha ma bixi doono ilaa dhammaan rakaabku ay xirtaan suumanka kuraasta.

translations.eng: The applicant has already submitted all verified legal documents to the woreda office.
translations.amh: አመልካቹ የተረጋገጡትን ህጋዊ ሰነዶች በሙሉ ለወረዳው ጽህፈት ቤት አስረክቧል።
translations.orm: Iyyataan sanadoota seera qabeeyyii mirkanaa'an hunda waajjira aanaatiif dhiyeesseera.
translations.tir: እቲ ኣመልካቲ ኩሎም ዝተረጋገጹ ሕጋዊ ሰነዳት ናብ ቤት ጽሕፈት ወረዳ ኣረኪቡ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Codsaduhu wuxuu mar hore dhammaan dukumentiyada sharciga ah ee la xaqiijiyay u gudbiyay xafiiska degmada.

translations.eng: Do not touch the broken high-voltage electrical cable lying on the road!
translations.amh: መንገዱ ላይ የወደቀውን የተበጠሰ ከፍተኛ የኤሌክትሪክ ገመድ በፍጹም እንዳትነኩ!
translations.orm: Shiboo elektiriikii humna guddaa citus karaa irra ciisu tasuma hin tuqinaa!
translations.tir: ኣብቲ መንገዲ ወዲቑ ዘሎ ዝተበትከ ናይ ላዕለዋይ ሓይሊ ኤለክትሪክ ገመድ ፈጺምኩም ኣይትተንክይዎ!
translations.som: Ha taabanina fiilada korontada ee go'an ee ku dhacday waddada dhexdeeda!

translations.eng: Please have a seat and drink this freshly brewed Ethiopian coffee.
translations.amh: እባክዎትን ይቀመጡ እና ይህንን ትኩስ የኢትዮጵያ ቡና ይጠጡ።
translations.orm: Mee maaloo taa'aa, buna Itoophiyaa haaraa dhangala'e kana dhugaa.
translations.tir: በጃኹም ተቐመጡ እሞ ነዚ ሓድሽ ዝተፈልሐ ናይ ኢትዮጵያ ቡን ስተዩ።
translations.som: Fadlan fariiso oo cab koobkan bunka Itoobiya ee hadda la kariyay.

translations.eng: If the Kiremt seasonal rains arrive early, the crop harvest will be plentiful.
translations.amh: የክረምት ወቅታዊ ዝናብ ቀድሞ ከመጣ የሰብል ምርቱ እጅግ የተትረፈረፈ ይሆናል።
translations.orm: Bokkaan gannaa yoo dursanii dhufe, oomishni midhaanii baay'ee quubsaa ta'a.
translations.tir: ናይ ክረምቲ ዝናብ ቀዲሙ እንተመጺኡ፡ ምህርቲ እኽሊ ኣዝዩ ሃብታም ክኸውን እዩ።
translations.som: Haddii roobabka xilliga gu'ga ay goor hore yimaadaan, waxsoosaarka dalaggu wuxuu noqon doonaa mid aad u barwaaqo ah.

translations.eng: If the ambulance had arrived ten minutes earlier, the blood loss would have been minimized.
translations.amh: አምቡላንሱ ከአስር ደቂቃ በፊት ደርሶ በነበረ ኖሮ የደም መፍሰሱ ይቀንስ ነበር።
translations.orm: Ambulaansiin daqiiqaa kudhan dura utuu ga'ee dhiigni dhangala'u ni xiqqaata ture.
translations.tir: ኣምቡላንስ ቅድሚ ዓሰርተ ደቒቕ በጺሑ እንተዝነብር፡ እቲ ምፍሳስ ደም ምቐነሰ ነይሩ።
translations.som: Haddii ambalaastu ay imaan lahayd toban daqiiqo ka hor, dhiig-baxu wuu yaraan lahaa.

translations.eng: Why has the distribution of subsidized edible oil been delayed this month?
translations.amh: በዚህ ወር የተደጎመው የምግብ ዘይት ስርጭት ለምን ዘገየ?
translations.orm: Ji'a kana raabsiin zayita nyaataa deeggersa mootummaa qabu maaliif ture?
translations.tir: ኣብዚ ወርሒ እዚ ናይቲ ድጎማ ዝተገብረሉ ናይ መግቢ ዘይቲ ዕደላ ስለምንታይ ደንጒዩ?
translations.som: Maxaa keenay in bishan uu dib u dhaco qaybinta saliidda cuntada ee la kabo?

translations.eng: Where is the nearest primary health center that administers rabies vaccines?
translations.amh: የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ መከላከያ ክትባት የሚሰጠው በአቅራቢያ የሚገኘው የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ጤና ጣቢያ የት ነው?
translations.orm: Buufanni fayyaa sadarkaa duraa kan talaallii dhukkuba saree marattuu kennu inni dhihoo eessa jira?
translations.tir: ናይ ዕቡድ ከልቢ መኸተሚ ክታበት ዝህብ ኣብ ቀረባ ዝርከብ ቀዳማይ ብርኪ ጥዕና ማእኸል ኣበይ ኣሎ?
translations.som: Halkeed bay ku taallaa xarunta caafimaadka aasaasiga ah ee kuugu dhow ee bixisa tallaalka cudurka raabiyada?

translations.eng: Would you like me to bring you another cup of spiced tea, honorable sir?
translations.amh: ክቡር ሆይ፣ ሌላ ተጨማሪ ኩባያ ቅመም ያለበት ሻይ ላምጣልዎት?
translations.orm: Kabajamaa koo, siinii shaayii urgooftuu qabu kan biraa siif haa fiduu?
translations.tir: ክቡር ኣይተ፡ ካልእ ተወሳኺ ኩባያ ቅመም ዘለዎ ሻሂ ከምጽኣልኩም ዶ?
translations.som: Mudane qaddarin leh, ma doonaysaa inaan kuu keeno koob kale oo shaaha xawaashka leh ah?

translations.eng: All motorcycle drivers must wear safety helmets and carry their valid licenses.
